rightsReview.basis: Bounded acquisition of official state legislative texts under the same documented basis as the closed programs: LFDA art. 14 frac. VIII (documented basis, not a legal conclusion). Verified 2026-11-13 before acquisition: robots.txt standard WordPress (Disallow: /wp-admin/ and podscache only, no AI-agent blocks, no content-signals); the site shows an Aviso Legal label but its destination is 404 and no terms-of-use page was located on home or catalog; the congress itself publishes direct download links. Absence of terms is NOT treated as express authorization by the owner. Scope limited to official normative texts (leyes, codigos, constitucion, reglamento interior, decretos normativos, series fiscales); internal manuals excluded; editorial/third-party content not covered by this basis is excluded. Quarantine only; no publication, no product activation. Stop the source if any restriction or challenge appears.
